Singularity.Algebra.exists_span_insert_e.type:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsLocalRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R] {x : R},
  x ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R →
    x ∉ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R ^ 2 →
      ∃ t,
        ↑t ⊆ ↑(IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) ∧
          t.card + 1 = Submodule.spanFinrank (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) ∧
            IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R = Ideal.span (insert x ↑t)
